decisive_finding.cause: FalsePassControlRequest::new accepts caller-selected control, context, candidate, truth surface, and ceiling values. LocalNegativeControlAuthority::execute always runs /usr/bin/false and derives the named failure contract and actor identities from those untrusted values.
decisive_finding.impact: One unrelated generic failure minted fresh-looking control receipts that elevated every adopted claim, including CL-RELEASE and CL-COMPLETION. Receipt freshness and private fields do not repair the missing causal and authority binding because the producer can request a new receipt for any selected target.

corrective_lease.required_result: Derive control semantics and target ceiling from one closed adopted definition; consume authority-originated actual named-control execution; reject generic, fabricated, replayed, stale, substituted, cross-claim, cross-candidate, report-only, and self-authored evidence.
